About WorkPacks: Nestled in the vibrant tech ecosystem of the USA, WorkPacks is an innovative startup reshaping the construction industry's future. We're in search of daring individuals who are eager to disrupt, envision, and build anew. As trailblazers in the digital arena, we're stretching the limits of what's possible and warmly invite you to embark on this exhilarating venture with us.


Position Overview: We’re looking for a motivated Key Account Manager / Implementation Lead who will serve as both a relationship builder and implementation expert. In this role, you’ll be the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring our software solutions align with their needs and integrate seamlessly into their operations. This fully remote role combines client engagement with hands-on deployment, offering the opportunity to be directly involved in both client satisfaction and product success.


Responsibilities:


  • Client Relationship Management: Cultivate strong, lasting relationships with key clients, ensuring they feel supported and valued.
  • Primary Point of Contact: Serve as the primary liaison for assigned accounts, providing responsive and reliable client support.
  • Implementation Planning: Develop, document, and manage comprehensive implementation plans, including client-specific requirements, configurations, and any necessary customizations.
  • Data Specification Documentation: Prepare technical specifications and manage electronic data interface (EDI) setup with clients for seamless integration.
  • Deployment Leadership: Lead software implementations at client locations as required, managing deployment to ensure successful integration and operation.
  • Client Collaboration: Work closely with clients to thoroughly understand their project requirements and guarantee successful software adoption.
  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Deliver hands-on technical support during the implementation phase, addressing issues quickly to maintain satisfaction.
  • Client Training: Educate clients and their teams on using our software effectively, enabling them to gain maximum benefit from the tools.
  • Feedback Loop with Development: Collaborate closely with the product development team, sharing field insights and client feedback to support ongoing product improvements.


Qualifications:


  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • Industry Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in the construction industry.
  • Technical Interest: Strong interest in construction technology and software solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for effective client engagement and support.
  • Problem-Solving Abilities: A detail-oriented approach with a proactive problem-solving mindset.
  • Multi-Project Management: Capability to manage multiple client accounts or projects simultaneously.
  • Willingness to Travel: Availability to travel to client sites as necessary.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Advanced Work Packaging (AWP): Familiarity with AWP methodologies.
  • Software Knowledge: Experience with construction management software or related technology.
  • Implementation Process Insight: Basic understanding of software implementation processes.
  • Client-Facing Experience: Previous experience in a client-focused role or account management.


Expectations


  • Remote Work: Fully remote position with flexibility and some overlap required with U.S. working hours.
  • Autonomous Drive: Proactive, creative, and capable of driving projects forward independently.
  • Hands-on Approach: Eager to engage with both client challenges and technical solutions directly.


Compensation:

  • Salary: Competitive salary starting at $55,000/year.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits.
  • Growth Opportunities: Paths for professional development and career advancement within the company.
  • Culture: A collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven workplace that values teamwork and individual initiative.


This role is perfect for a client-focused, tech-savvy professional passionate about transforming the construction industry through technology. Join us to shape the future of construction, drive client success, and take the lead in groundbreaking software implementations!

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Engineer (Relocation to Portugal) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:


Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems. With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation. Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 3 years of experience as a Data Engineer;
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and data integration solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and modern data engineering concepts.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms, databases, and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).
  • Availability and willingness to relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team-building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!


If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!


The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract; Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). description:

Junior Customer Support Analyst (Technical Support)


About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join a global technology team supporting innovative digital products and platforms.

This is a long-term remote opportunity for professionals based in Brazil who enjoy solving problems, helping customers, and working closely with product and engineering teams in a fast-paced environment.

The ideal candidate combines strong customer service skills with technical curiosity and the ability to troubleshoot software-related issues.

title: B2B SDR / Appointment Setter — Remote LATAM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para B2B SDR / Appointment Setter — Remote LATAM em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

B2B Appointment Setter


Compensation:

  • Base: $2500 USD/month + $50 USD per qualified booked call
  • Our Target: 15 qualified booked calls per month (realistic earnings $3,250+/month, uncapped)


Apply Here to Stand Out: (


Connect With Us:


  • LinkedIn:
  • Twitter/X:
  • Company: gpsocials.com 


This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration.


The Opportunity:


We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.


Here's What Makes Us Different:


  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):


You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.


The Role: B2B Appointment Setter


Core Responsibilities:


1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses
  • ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
  • ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
  • ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
  • ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

  • ❌ No proven B2B setting experience 
  • ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role

You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say \"yeah, let's talk\"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
  • Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped

The Package: What's In It for You

Compensation:

  • Base: $2500 USD/month
  • Performance Bonus: $50 USD per qualified booked call that shows up to the discovery call
  • Our Target: 15 qualified booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
  • The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.


The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
  • ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
  • Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

Junior Customer Support Analyst (Technical Support)


About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join a global technology team supporting innovative digital products and platforms.

This is a long-term remote opportunity for professionals based in Brazil who enjoy solving problems, helping customers, and working closely with product and engineering teams in a fast-paced environment.

title: B2B SDR / Appointment Setter — Remote LATAM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para B2B SDR / Appointment Setter — Remote LATAM em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

B2B Appointment Setter


Compensation:

  • Base: $2500 USD/month + $50 USD per qualified booked call
  • Our Target: 15 qualified booked calls per month (realistic earnings $3,250+/month, uncapped)


Apply Here to Stand Out: (


Connect With Us:


  • LinkedIn:
  • Twitter/X:
  • Company: gpsocials.com 


This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration.


The Opportunity:


We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.


Here's What Makes Us Different:


  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):


You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.


The Role: B2B Appointment Setter


Core Responsibilities:


1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses
  • ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
  • ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
  • ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
  • ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

  • ❌ No proven B2B setting experience 
  • ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role

You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say \"yeah, let's talk\"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
  • Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped

The Package: What's In It for You

Compensation:

  • Base: $2500 USD/month
  • Performance Bonus: $50 USD per qualified booked call that shows up to the discovery call
  • Our Target: 15 qualified booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
  • The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.


The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
  • ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
  • Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand.


A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries.


The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements.

The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions.


Task and deliverables:

  • Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools.
  • Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules.
  • Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response.
  • Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices.
  • Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries.
  • Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team.
  • Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.


Required experience:

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience.
  • Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts.
  • Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation.
  • Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases.
  • Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development.
  • Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation.
  • Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance.
  • Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team.
  • Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams.
  • Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.


Engagement highlights:

  • Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries.
  • Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design.
  • Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Virtual Assistant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sales Virtual Assistant — Appointment Setting & Closing for a US CEO (Remote)

Read this whole thing before you apply. It's a filter.

We place sales-driven Virtual Assistants with US home-service business owners. You won't be a task-rabbit. You'll be the CEO's right hand — the person who moves the needle on whatever the business needs that week.


Your #1 job: make sure deals close. Appointment setting, direct sales, follow-up that doesn't quit. From there it widens — hiring providers, dispatching, customer satisfaction, finding new ways to grow the business. We're not hiring an assistant. We're hiring a mini-CEO who makes the big CEO's life bigger.


This role is for people who take the reins. Nobody is going to hand you a checklist every morning. You see the gap, you close the gap. If you need to be told what to do next, stop reading — this will frustrate both of us.


The pay grows when you do:

  • Start at $1,000/mo
  • Hit your first KPI → $1,250/mo
  • Hit the next → $1,400/mo
  • Performance bonuses from the business owner on top — up to $400/mo more


The ceiling moves because you move it. We don't cap people who produce.


What you need to have:

  • Fluent, clear, neutral English — easy for a US homeowner to understand on a call
  • Proven sales or appointment-setting background (show us the receipts)
  • Comfortable owning a number, not just doing tasks
  • Cold calling experience — you'll be on the phone, this isn't optional


The non-negotiables — apply only if these are a yes:

  • Able to work US business hours (any zone, PST–EST)
  • Up to 50 hours/week. This is firm.
  • Saturday mornings when the business needs it
  • Comfortable with Hubstaff time tracking. We use it for transparency, not to micromanage or punish — that's not how we operate. But it's part of the job.


If you read the hours and the ownership bar and felt more interested, not less — you're who we're looking for. We're filling this seat now. Hit Easy Apply today. If you're a fit, you'll hear from us within 48 hours — we move fast when we find the right person.

BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. title: Remote Mathematics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • PhD / Doctorate
  • Designed and defined novel mathematical systems, operations, and axiomatic frameworks for reasoning evaluations.
  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

description:

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. Next Match AI LLC  is seeking a highly motivated, adaptable Junior Developer  to join our distributed global software engineering team. As our automated AI matching networks and foundational HR API  infrastructure experience rapid commercial adoption across North America and the GCC, we are expanding our core technical team to support feature deployment, database optimization, and high-volume data validation holds.

Operating completely remote from within Brazil, you will work alongside senior software architects to write clean code, squash system bugs, and optimize front-end and back-end modules. You will play a vital, hands-on role in scaling our cloud ecosystems, collaborating directly with our core engineering and innovation hub in Abu Dhabi .

  • Feature Development & Maintenance:  Write clean, testable code to build and refine responsive user interfaces and backend logic layers.

  • Strong Problem-Solving Drive:  A sharp analytical mindset with an eagerness to learn complex cloud architectures under the mentorship of senior engineers.
  • Excellent Communication:  Clear, structured verbal and written English communication skills; a natural ability to collaborate effectively across remote, distributed channels. (Portuguese language capability is your native framework; English is required for architecture syncs).
  • Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical coding boot camp credentials).
Premium Compensation & Benefits

We offer a high-tier early-career compensation portfolio built to secure the region's brightest rising tech talent, positioned strictly 20% above the Brazilian market average .

  • Base Salary:  R$ 8,400 – R$ 10,500 BRL per month  (Paid out via equivalent USD stable contract options of $1,600 – $2,000 USD , dependent on portfolio depth and technical evaluation performance).
  • Remote Excellence:  100% remote workflow autonomy paired with a dedicated personal technology stipend and home-office equipment setup allowance.
  • Health & Wellness:  Comprehensive, high-tier medical insurance coverage provided fully for you and your immediate family members.

(Salary and benefits to be discussed based on experience and fit.)

Job description


BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, strategists, and junior developers to deliver pixel-perfect, high-performance sites—on time, on budget, and at the cutting edge of Webflow’s capabilities. olá, dev sênior fullstack!


somos a teceo, a plataforma unificada que conecta marcas e lojistas, a qualquer hora, de qualquer lugar.


a teceo está construindo o próximo estágio do produto. inteligência de decisão de compra, visibilidade de sell-out, reposição automatizada. pra isso, precisamos de engenharia que entenda produto, que consiga conectar complexidade técnica com impacto real no negócio. é uma vaga pra quem quer construir algo que ainda não existe.


buscamos alguém sênior de verdade: com autonomia pra tomar decisão técnica, sem precisar de mão na mão, e com maturidade pra entender que a solução certa nem sempre é a mais sofisticada.


no dia a dia, você vai atuar em produto, colaborar com engenharia e negócio, e contribuir diretamente pra evolução da plataforma. a stack é Nest + React + PostgreSQL, e você precisa dominar as duas pontas, não só uma delas.


para fazer parte do time, buscamos pessoas que queiram se arriscar, sair da zona de conforto e transformar o mercado da moda e lifestyle. se você quer construir produto de verdade, em um ambiente que cobra e entrega, essa vaga é pra você.

  • gere as documentações de negócio e especificação técnica com IA

  • projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis e de alta qualidade

  • atuar na evolução técnica, trazendo tecnologias e melhorias


o que procuramos em você

  • sólida experiência em Node.js, preferencialmente NestJS
  • sólida experiência com arquitetura de sistemas: banco, serviços, filas
  • sólida experiência com banco relacional, REST e integrações
  • sólida experiência com SOLID e Clean Code
  • experiência com ReactJS
  • experiência em liderar iniciativas técnicas, formal ou informalmente
  • experiência com CI/CD, Docker e testes
  • desejável: AWS e Kubernetes
  • mínimo de 5 anos de experiência


o que oferecemos:

  • modelo de contratação PJ
  • programa de SOP
  • bonificação semestral
  • cartão Swile e TotalPass
  • formato home-office
  • horário & descanso flexíveis
  • bootcamp-teceo ~ imersão presencial anual com o time
  • fio-da-meada ~ rumos & números do negócio em uma reunião trimestral


nenhum bom negócio é feito sozinho. quer entrar pro time? fale com a gente!

title: Remote Mathematics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • PhD / Doctorate
  • Designed and defined novel mathematical systems, operations, and axiomatic frameworks for reasoning evaluations.
  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Video Content Intern
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Content Intern em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Type: Internship, 6 hours/day (30 hours/week)

Compensation: R$2,000/month

About the Role

We're an early-stage stealth startup in the health and wellness space, building our brand from the ground up. We're looking for a creative, fast-moving video intern who can turn raw footage and ideas into scroll-stopping short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and ads. You'll work directly with the founder and play a key role in how our brand shows up on video. Great opportunity for someone early in their career who loves editing and wants real ownership over content that thousands of people will see.

What You'll Do

  • Edit short-form video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and paid ads (15-60 second formats)
  • Turn influencer footage, raw clips, and simple briefs into polished, platform-ready videos
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and light motion to make content engaging
  • Repurpose one piece of content into multiple formats and cuts
  • Format and optimize videos to spec for each platform
  • Help maintain an organized library of footage and assets
  • Occasionally create simple graphics or thumbnails to support video content

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken. The interview will be conducted in English.
  • Strong editing skills in CapCut, and/or CapCut, Premiere, or similar (essential)
  • A real sense for what makes short-form video engaging, hooks, pacing, retention
  • Fast turnaround, comfortable producing multiple edits per day
  • Organized and reliable with deadlines
  • Self-motivated; you'll get briefs and direction, but we want someone who brings ideas
  • Available 6 hours per day

Nice to Have

  • Experience editing for health, wellness, fitness, or DTC/e-commerce brands
  • Basic motion graphics or animation skills
  • An eye for trends, you watch a lot of TikTok and know what's working right now

What You'll Get

  • Real, hands-on experience producing content for a brand from day one
  • Direct mentorship from the founder
  • Flexible remote work

Sales Virtual Assistant — Appointment Setting & Closing for a US CEO (Remote)

Read this whole thing before you apply. It's a filter.

We place sales-driven Virtual Assistants with US home-service business owners. You won't be a task-rabbit. You'll be the CEO's right hand — the person who moves the needle on whatever the business needs that week.

The non-negotiables — apply only if these are a yes:

If you read the hours and the ownership bar and felt more interested, not less — you're who we're looking for. We're filling this seat now. Hit Easy Apply today. If you're a fit, you'll hear from us within 48 hours — we move fast when we find the right person.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Webflow Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description


BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, strategists, and junior developers to deliver pixel-perfect, high-performance sites—on time, on budget, and at the cutting edge of Webflow’s capabilities. Fluency in English and a friendly, professional demeanor are essential.


What you’ll do

  • Lead builds end-to-end—from scoping and wireframes to launch and post-launch optimizations.
  • Architect scalable Webflow systems (components, class structures, CMS schema) using Client-First or similar methodologies.
  • Mentor and review junior developers, establishing best practices for accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
  • Implement advanced features such as memberships, logic flows, complex animations, e-commerce, API and Zapier/Make integrations, and custom code embeds.
  • Translate design files (Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD) into production-ready Webflow sites with perfect fidelity and micro-interaction polish.
  • Optimize SEO, page speed, and analytics, ensuring Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals targets are met.
  • Interface directly with clients and internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance, accurate estimates, and proactive solutions.
  • Continuously improve our workflow, researching new Webflow releases, no-code tools, and automation to keep BX Studio at the forefront of the industry.


Role requirements

  • 3+ years of professional Webflow development (or 6+ years front-end with 3+ in Webflow).
  • Demonstrated portfolio of complex, high-traffic Webflow sites—including CMS, e-commerce, and custom interactions.
  • Expert-level understanding of Client-First nomenclature and component libraries (Relume, Flowbase, etc.).
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST/GraphQL APIs; comfortable writing custom code when Webflow’s native tools aren’t enough.
  • Sharp eye for detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across breakpoints and browsers.
  • Leadership and mentorship experience—able to set code standards, run code reviews, and upskill teammates.
  • Strong project-management skills: accurate scoping, clear documentation, and a track record of hitting deadlines.
  • High degree of reliability, initiative, and integrity in a fully remote environment.
  • Availability to work core hours in either EST or PST time zones.

Location:  100% Remote (Must reside in Brazil)

Liaison Hub:  Abu Dhabi, UAE

Company:  Next Match AI LLC

Reference ID:  NMAI-JDEV-BR-023

The Opportunity

Next Match AI LLC  is seeking a highly motivated, adaptable Junior Developer  to join our distributed global software engineering team. As our automated AI matching networks and foundational HR API  infrastructure experience rapid commercial adoption across North America and the GCC, we are expanding our core technical team to support feature deployment, database optimization, and high-volume data validation holds.

Operating completely remote from within Brazil, you will work alongside senior software architects to write clean code, squash system bugs, and optimize front-end and back-end modules. You will play a vital, hands-on role in scaling our cloud ecosystems, collaborating directly with our core engineering and innovation hub in Abu Dhabi .

Key Responsibilities
  • Feature Development & Maintenance:  Write clean, testable code to build and refine responsive user interfaces and backend logic layers.
  • API Integration Support:  Assist in maintaining and documenting our core HR API  pathways, ensuring reliable data handshakes with third-party corporate client environments.
  • Bug Remediation:  Actively identify, debug, and resolve front-end layout shifts and server-side script errors to ensure a seamless web experience.
  • Database Optimization:  Write and optimize basic database queries, assisting senior engineers with structured data management and transactional logging.
  • Technical Documentation:  Keep internal engineering docs, API logs, and deployment workflows meticulously updated to support codebase transparency.
Who You Are (Requirements)
  • Proven Foundation Experience:  1+ years of professional software development experience, a dedicated internship background, or a robust portfolio of live full-stack web applications.
  • Core Tech Stack Familiarity:  Hands-on exposure to modern front-end tools (JavaScript/TypeScript, React, or Vue) and backend environments (Node.js, Python, or equivalent framework logic).
  • Database & Git Comfort:  Fundamental understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and solid familiarity with version control protocols (Git/GitHub).
  • Strong Problem-Solving Drive:  A sharp analytical mindset with an eagerness to learn complex cloud architectures under the mentorship of senior engineers.
  • Excellent Communication:  Clear, structured verbal and written English communication skills; a natural ability to collaborate effectively across remote, distributed channels. (Portuguese language capability is your native framework; English is required for architecture syncs).
  • Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical coding boot camp credentials).
Premium Compensation & Benefits

We offer a high-tier early-career compensation portfolio built to secure the region's brightest rising tech talent, positioned strictly 20% above the Brazilian market average .

  • Base Salary:  R$ 8,400 – R$ 10,500 BRL per month  (Paid out via equivalent USD stable contract options of $1,600 – $2,000 USD , dependent on portfolio depth and technical evaluation performance).
  • Remote Excellence:  100% remote workflow autonomy paired with a dedicated personal technology stipend and home-office equipment setup allowance.
  • Health & Wellness:  Comprehensive, high-tier medical insurance coverage provided fully for you and your immediate family members.

(Salary and benefits to be discussed based on experience and fit.)

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand.


A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries.


The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements.

The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions.


Task and deliverables:

  • Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools.
  • Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules.
  • Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response.
  • Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices.
  • Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries.
  • Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team.
  • Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.


Required experience:

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience.
  • Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts.
  • Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation.
  • Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases.
  • Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development.
  • Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation.
  • Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance.
  • Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team.
  • Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams.
  • Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.


Engagement highlights:

  • Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries.
  • Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design.
  • Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

title: desenvolvedor sênior | NodeJS & ReactJS
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para desenvolvedor sênior | NodeJS & ReactJS em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

olá, dev sênior fullstack!


somos a teceo, a plataforma unificada que conecta marcas e lojistas, a qualquer hora, de qualquer lugar.


a teceo está construindo o próximo estágio do produto. inteligência de decisão de compra, visibilidade de sell-out, reposição automatizada. pra isso, precisamos de engenharia que entenda produto, que consiga conectar complexidade técnica com impacto real no negócio. é uma vaga pra quem quer construir algo que ainda não existe.


buscamos alguém sênior de verdade: com autonomia pra tomar decisão técnica, sem precisar de mão na mão, e com maturidade pra entender que a solução certa nem sempre é a mais sofisticada.


no dia a dia, você vai atuar em produto, colaborar com engenharia e negócio, e contribuir diretamente pra evolução da plataforma. a stack é Nest + React + PostgreSQL, e você precisa dominar as duas pontas, não só uma delas.


para fazer parte do time, buscamos pessoas que queiram se arriscar, sair da zona de conforto e transformar o mercado da moda e lifestyle. se você quer construir produto de verdade, em um ambiente que cobra e entrega, essa vaga é pra você.


nosso fluxo de desenvolvimento orientado a IA:

  • gere as documentações de negócio e especificação técnica com IA
  • use open code, claude code e demais ferramentas para codificação
  • fluxo de review e refinamento de código feito via agentes (coderabbit)
  • correção de bugs via agentes


o que você vai fazer

  • projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis e de alta qualidade
  • escrever testes automatizados para as principais funcionalidades
  • participar de decisões técnicas de arquitetura com o time
  • atuar na evolução técnica, trazendo tecnologias e melhorias


o que procuramos em você

  • sólida experiência em Node.js, preferencialmente NestJS
  • sólida experiência com arquitetura de sistemas: banco, serviços, filas
  • sólida experiência com banco relacional, REST e integrações
  • sólida experiência com SOLID e Clean Code
  • experiência com ReactJS
  • experiência em liderar iniciativas técnicas, formal ou informalmente
  • experiência com CI/CD, Docker e testes
  • desejável: AWS e Kubernetes
  • mínimo de 5 anos de experiência


o que oferecemos:
